source.name: BnL raw ground truth newspapers before 1878
source.declared_scope: 1702 uncropped newspaper text-block image/ALTO pairs; German, French or Luxembourgish; transcription manually double-keyed to at least 99.95% accuracy

selection.pool: numeric member IDs 0000 through 1701, excluding the 24 A45 IDs; established from identifiers only
selection.rule: exclude A45 IDs, sort remaining IDs by SHA-256 of UTF-8 BBVLM-A54:<ID>, take first 16

predeclared_use.ocr: independent comparison of unchanged PERO candidate against one image-plus-candidate Luna correction pass
predeclared_use.layout: independent text-line and diagnostic word-box validation of unchanged PERO/A37 output
predeclared_use.primary_gate: search_v1 aggregate CER must improve and no search_v1-exact PERO block may regress
predeclared_use.secondary_gate: lexical_alnum aggregate CER must improve and no lexical-exact PERO block may regress
predeclared_use.language_filter: report every selected block and a French stratum; language never changes membership
predeclared_use.reference_opening: only after candidate outputs and VLM inputs are sealed
